description: Connect SAP SuccessFactors to automate employee and organization records.

sap_successfactors_job_changed_trigger.description: Runs when job changed is observed. Existing records are noted when the workflow is turned on. Checks complete lists on your workspace plan’s polling interval; lists over 4,000 records or 100 pages are refused.

output.record: The complete record returned by the service.

output.record: The complete record returned by the service.

output.record: The complete record returned by the service.
